sn38.14:1.1: Dukkham dukkhanti āvuso Sāriputta vuccati || katamaṃ nu kho āvuso dukkhanti || || Tisso imāvuso dukkhatā || dukkhadukkhatā saṅkhāradukkhatā vipariṇāmadukkhatā || imā kho avuso dukkhatā ti || || Atthi panāvuso maggo atthi paṭipadā etāsaṃ dukkhatānam pariññāyāti || || Atthi kho āvuso maggo atthi paṭipadā etāsaṃ dukkhatānam pariññāyāti || || Katamo panāvuso maggo katamā paṭipadā etāsaṃ dukkhatānam pariññāyāti || || Ayam eva kho āvuso ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo etāsaṃ dukkhatānam pariññāya || seyyathīdaṃ sammādiṭṭhi || pe || sammāsamādhi || ayaṃ kho āvuso maggo ayam paṭipadā etāsam dukkhatānam pariññāyāti || || Bhaddako āvuso maggo bhaddikā paṭipadā etāsam dukkhatānam pariññāya || alañca panāvuso Sāriputta appamādāyāti || || Sakkāyo
